chain_words.nuance: correct in the details of the original
staying near the wording and structure of the source
keeping the meaning and spirit of the original intact
conveying the original's essence in a reliable way
devoted to the author's intention, even at some cost to the surface text

explanation: These words all describe how closely a translation follows its source, from exact details to a devoted loyalty to the author's intention.

usage_notes.difference: 'Faithful' means keeping the meaning and spirit of the original intact; 'loyal' stresses devotion to the author's intention, sometimes even at the cost of the literal text.
